_comment: Wayfarer exterior design data (dossier bod 3; author 1. 10. 2026: one source of data - the drawings and the ship are made from the same data). Built elements live in the build data (HardSurface/Wayfarer_hs.json, Wayfarer_setup.json) with their IDs; this file holds what is not built yet: 'proposed' elements (drawn blue), and 'changes' to built elements ('change' with the new values in 'set', 'remove' drawn red crossed). Read by Tools/Design/exterior_model.py (drawings, Tools/Tests/test_exterior_drawing.py) and later by the exterior kit builder. Layout coordinates: x from the aft end, y to port, z from the deck; pod angles 0 outboard, 90 top. Mirrored elements (the default) have one ID for both sides.
_revision_D: 1. 10. 2026, kit pilot critic round 1 (FAIL 5.4): a wide spine with a crest, T-profile ribs and longerons with bolt rows, doubler panels and small hatches on the roof plates (three plate sizes), a darker channel floor, the ramp with tread bars, a rubber threshold, a hinge, a heavier frame with corner gussets, hydraulic cylinders with clevis brackets and hoses, a bigger RCS block, lamp bodies with position lenses and a work light; the author approves D with the pilot; 2. 10. 2026 kit pilot step c (critic round 3): the shoulder plates S with doubler panels, hatches and conduits F-CONDUIT-S, the secondary paint lighter, warmer and duller, the aft wall as plates P-S-A on the frame FR-AFT with vent boxes (replacing P-B-08 / P-B-09)
_revision_E: 2. 10. 2026, kit pilot step d: the main engine nozzles (rolled lip with a heat-tinted collar, a converging bell with two rings and 12 ribs, a throat ring, a centre body on four tie rods, the emissive core behind the throat; detail G on E-05) and the pods within their triangle budget (60 k); awaits the author's approval
_revision_F: 3. 10. 2026, whole-ship kit critic round 3 (FAIL 6.0, sides and nose darker than the drawing and concept B); the author approved the four data changes from Docs/Reviews/2026-10-03_wayfarer_ship_kit.md: the keel band K in the white paint (was gunmetal), the dark channel between bands L and U narrowed (L up to v 0.497), full-height ribs FR-RIB only at the main bulkheads 1.4 / 8.2 / 10.4 / 15.2 (the others only from FR-LONG-HI over the shoulder and roof, plain plate seams below), the nose as fewer, bigger plates (K14, L14, U14 to the RCS block, one plate P-S-N15 forward of it); the drawings await the author's approval before the build
_revision_G: 3. 10. 2026, critic of the revision F sides (PASS 6.5, points 1 and 2; author: continue with them): the side mid layer - vent boxes XK-VENTBOX on five side plates K04, K09, L12, U13, L14 (author 3. 10. 2026: five, irregular, none above another, all clear of the pod) and doubler panels with small hatches also on the keel band K and the nose plate N; the plate numbers D-R-PANEL-NUMBERS on the bands K, L, U and N too; awaits the author's approval before the build

panels._comment: Hull side plates (B + C): one plate in every frame bay of every band. Bays lie between the hull's seam stations (recipe parts.hull.seams.x) and the hull ends; band heights are section fractions v (0 keel .. 1 roof at that station, as the hull loft scales its section), so the bands follow the nose taper. Plates are cut by the canopy and its seal, the dark nose tip and aft cap, the recesses and the hatches named in 'cut'; a piece under min_area_m2 or narrower than min_width_m (a strip left round a grille) is left out and the frame shows there. ID: P-S-<band><bay>.
panels._built_bands: bands built by the kit: the pilot R, S, A (1. 10. 2026), the whole ship K, L, U from 3. 10. 2026, the nose plate N (revision F, 3. 10. 2026)
panels._seam_gap: 15 mm each side of a plain plate seam at a station without a rib (revision F, author 3. 10. 2026: full-height ribs only at the main bulkheads; the plates meet at a 30 mm seam, not a 130 mm dark rib bay)
panels._gap: 25 mm between a plate and the frame (whole-ship kit critic rounds 1-2, 3. 10. 2026: the dark frame and channel outweighed the white plates; was 40 mm)
panels._cut_hardware: every built or proposed part on the hull side (greebles, functional parts) also gets a cut-out in the plate with cut_margin: the plates are 30-40 mm proud and would bury it (critic round 2, 1. 10. 2026)

ID: P-S-S<bay>-D / -H.

aft.name: zadní stěna
aft._comment: The aft wall as plates on a frame (kit pilot step c, author 2. 10. 2026; critic round 3: the stern read as an empty white box). Outline = the aft-facing wall under the aft cap, port half (y >= 0, AFT view y, z), mirrored. The frame FR-AFT (members below) splits it: the ramp frame F-RAMP-FRAME is the inner frame; beside the ramp a lower and an upper plate, above the beam an outer plate each side and a centre plate round the ramp light. Plates keep gap off the members and cut_margin off the parts (ramp frame, pistons, vents, the ramp light). Replaces the recipe plates P-B-08 / P-B-09. ID: P-S-A<side><n> (L port, P starboard, C centre).
aft._normal: -0.2, not -0.4: on the rear chamfer the outboard faces turn sideways and -0.4 cut the upper plates along the triangles (a ragged edge with the dark channel in it, step c editor shots)
aft._skin_z_max: the dark channel skin between the plates only on the upright wall: on the rear chamfer the hull is a few big triangles and a face taken by its centre stuck out above the plates as dark shards (step c editor shots)
aft._clear: decals the plates keep clear of (cut_margin): the hazard bands beside the ramp frame stay on the wall between the frame and the plates

sub._comment: Three plate sizes on the roof (critic round 1, 1. 10. 2026): on every R plate a doubler panel (XK-DOUBLER) - in odd bays a long strip by the spine, in even bays a square panel, in vent_bays a vent box (XK-VENTBOX, critic round 2) instead - and a small flush hatch (XK-HATCH) towards the roof edge; each keeps 70 mm off the plate's edges and cut-outs, slides along the bay to clear them, or is left out. y from the plate's inner edge. ID: P-S-R<side><bay>-D / -H.

roof._comment: Roof plates (author 1. 10. 2026: primary paint on the roof, gunmetal only on the belly): in every bay one plate each side of the centre line, from the spine (spine_gap: the spine longeron's half width + 40 mm) over the roof edge down to v_edge on the upper shoulder (40 mm above the top longeron FR-LONG-TOP). Drawn and built in plan (x, y); cut like the side plates (canopy seal, aft cap, recesses, hatches, every part on the roof). ID: P-S-RL<bay> (port), P-S-RP<bay> (starboard).
